_comment: Self-contained GitHub daemon profile. Select with `CodeReviewDaemon --review achieveai`. Reviews achieveai/LmDotnetTools through the achieveai/AchieveAiReviews cross-repo store (tool-assisted, sub-agents). The primary reviewer runs gpt-5.6-sol; the code-review mode owns authoritative per-subagent_type Sol/Terra/Luna child routing and an xhigh effort floor, so this profile deliberately leaves SubAgentModelId empty. LIVE-POSTING: EnableCommentPosting is true ⇒ this profile is the deployed Revobot poster (crd-daemon-revobot) and POSTS review comments to the PR. It shares port 5080 + the review-pool with that daemon, so run only ONE poster at a time — do NOT launch this alongside crd-daemon-revobot. For a local dry run that posts nothing, set EnableCommentPosting:false. Machine-specific absolute paths below; this is a fresh instance (its own .run DB) — point DatabasePath at crd-daemon-revobot/review-opus.db to continue that daemon's history.

Github._comment: GitHub CLI (gh) first-party OAuth App id + secret (public, safe to embed — same convention as LmStreaming.Sample). Required so SandboxSessionRegistry attaches the github-auth egress rule for the sandbox; the auth-webhook then injects the EXISTING stored token (crd-oauth-tokens/github.json, scopes repo/read:org/workflow/gist) for the review agent's api.github.com calls (code-reviewer:post-pr-review).

CodeReviewDaemon._KnowledgeModelId_comment: SPEND-NEUTRALITY PIN. This key was inert on the S2S path until S2SReviewAgentLoopFactory started forwarding modelId as the conversation's provider id; its previous value here was 'claude-opus-4.8', which the factory silently ignored, so the at-close extraction passes have in fact been running on gpt-5.6-luna. Pinned to the model actually in use so the plumbing fix changes no spend. Restoring 'claude-opus-4.8' is now a real, one-token config edit — and it will now take effect.
